purpose: Formal model argument, descriptive relationships, duplicate-weight stress, and full 24-corridor conditional assessment
source_available_equity_rule: Exclude suppressed_CT_imputed corridor estimates from source-available correlation only; retain all 16 candidates in every decision ranking
screen_interpretation: Exploratory absolute-rho flag, not a hypothesis test, causal claim or automatic deletion threshold
block_allocation_rule: Fixed block budget split equally among the surviving indicators in that block; conceptual block allocation does not imply all correlations vanish
deletion_rule: Retain block_equal budgets, reallocate a deleted member only within its own block; leave source values and equity reference unchanged
broader_ablation_rule: Leave each of the five current indicators out in turn, proportionally renormalize each original v0.7 profile; report all 30 cases without treating every deletion as an equally desirable model
continuous_prior: Dirichlet(1,1,1) over three conceptual block budgets, independent uniform City minimum/mean method; equal split inside each block
balanced_region_interpretation: Report the subset of broad-prior draws inside this illustrative region; it is not an elicited stakeholder acceptance region and is not selected to guarantee corridor 23
continuous_frequency_interpretation: Preference-prior-dependent rank acceptability, not statistical confidence or immunity to all missing-data and indicator adjustments
conditional_assessment: Compute the same five-indicator contextual index for each conditional corridor in each original profile/method, preserve baseline labels and source/substitution flags, report no cross-baseline rank, and link all prerequisite-bundle union/incremental coverage
single_corridor_policy: Choose one added evaluated corridor against CITY_BASE_0; require prerequisites to already belong to the decision baseline before an extension can join this unanchored main comparison. This is an explicit study policy, not a claim the case waived assessment of eight candidates.
principle_coverage_rule: Separate directly scored need proxies, indirect pathways, unscored current residential-intensity context, and unavailable growth/employment/accessibility outcomes. Do not claim full three-principle empirical coverage or use cost-normalized City scores.
slide_claim_rule: Present the 12-to-23 decision reversal prominently. State 100% top5 inclusion only for the previously tested six-vs-five paired scenario support; reject absolute robustness, 100% immunity and confirmed official-error claims.
